replies.author: Junr
replies.body: First computer game ever got was this and now seeing it go is sad. It will be on the phone now, but it won't be the same feeling as the conputer. One christmas, I got 3 membership cards and I never used them. We tried activating them yesterday, but it didn't work because they stated: "January 31, 2017 is the last day to redeem/buy Memberships", yet it was still January 31st and they should of stated the 30th was the last day. Well, every great thing comes to an end unfortunately.
